power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: Dadka gurguurta ayaa kaa baqaya, mana soo dhowaan doonaan.
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: Waxay qaadataa 0.5 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii inta lagu jiro biyaha ama roobka - dhogorta qoyan waa murugo.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Guba tamarta 30% ka dhaqso badan qofka.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: Qalcadda socodka birta iyo doonista - ku dhawaad ma guurto, laakiin gaabis ah oo u nugul kulaylka.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Iska caabbinta Joogtada ah I - dhejinta birta waxay kaxaysaa dharbaaxada xitaa iyadoo aan la qalabayn.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Dhismayaasha dhaadheer
power.neoorigins.golem_size.description: Miyuu 30% ka weyn yahay ciyaartoyga caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: Ka difaaca sunta, engega, iyo gaajada.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: Wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa 25% ka hooseeya bini'aadamka caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: Waxay qaadataa 80% waxyeello dheeraad ah oo ka timaada dabka, lavaga, iyo xiriirka magma block - birta waxay qabataa kulayl.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Godadka ka dhashay
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: Ku soo barbaaray mugdiga qoto dheer - wuxuu cunaa dhagax ceeriin, wuxuu ku ruugay macdan gacmo qaawan, laakiin wuxuu ku engegaa iftiinka qorraxda.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Indhaha ku dheggan mugdiga qoto dheer - looma baahna qoryo.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: Wuxuu yaqaan sida dhulka aan sinnayn.Ma qaado waxyeelo dhicid
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: Wuxuu jebiyaa dhammaan baloogyada laba jeer si degdeg ah - dhagaxu wuxuu u soo baxaa gacmo la yaqaan.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Gacmo qaawan baan u haystaa sida cawska dhagaxa ah - jebiya macdanta iyo dhagaxa bilaa qalab.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: Halka Luck uu firfircoon yahay (oo ay ku siiso dheeman cunista), baloogyada macdanta ayaa hoos u dhacaya sidii iyagoo la macdan Fortune II.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Dhagxaan Cuna
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Waxa uu cuni karaa dhagax-dhagaxa, dhagaxa, granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, deepslate, deepslate cobbled, basalt, iyo blackstone nafaqayn dhexdhexaad ah.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Cunto fungal ah
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: Fangaska dufan iyo casaanka leh waa cunto ku habboon Nether-ka-midig-guji si aad u cunto 5 gaajo iyo 0.6 saturation.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Waxa uu cuni karaa naxaasta maxasta ah, naxaasta ceeriin, macdanta naxaasta, macdanta naxaasta ah ee qoto dheer, iyo baloogyada naxaasta ceeriin - cunto fudud oo u dhaxaysa dhagaxa iyo birta.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Birta birta
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Waxa uu cuni karaa miskaha birta, birta ceyriinka ah, xadiidka birta, macdanta birta, macdanta birta ee qoto dheer, iyo blocks-ka birta ceeriin - cunto ku haboon macdanta.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Dabo-beelka
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Waxa uu cuni karaa faashad dahab ah, dahab cayriin, tufaax dahab ah, macdan dahab ah, macdano dahab ah, iyo macdano dahab ah, iyo dhagaxyo dahab ah oo ceyriin ah - cunno ka sii wanaagsan.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Waxa uu cuni karaa dheemanka, macdanta dheemanka, iyo macdanta dheemanta ee qotodheer - oo u dhiganta karootada dahabiga ah ee dheregta.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Waxay cuni kartaa emeralds, emerald ore, iyo deepslate emerald ore - cuntada ugu qanisan ee gaaban netherite.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
Waxa ay cuni kartaa ingot netherite, qashinka, iyo qashinka qadiimiga ah - cuntada ugu qanisan adduunka.Uma dhici doonto calool buuxa.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Cunista naxaasta waxay ku caawisaa Neefsashada Biyaha I ilaa 60 ilbiriqsi.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Cunista birta waxay ku deeqaysaa degdegga I ilaa 60 ilbiriqsi.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Cunista dahabka deeqaha Xawaaraha I ilaa 2 daqiiqo.
Cunista dheemanka waxay ku deeqdaa Luck II 5 daqiiqo - waxay awood u siineysaa Macdanta Fortune iyadoo firfircoon.
Cunista sumurud waxay ku siinaysaa iska caabbinta dabka 5 daqiiqo - ilayska qorraxdu wali wuu ku shidaa, laakiin kuma gubi karo.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Cunista netherite waxay bixisaa Xoog I iyo iska caabinta I ilaa 5 daqiiqo.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Dab ayuu qabtaa oo wuxuu qaataa 1 dhaawac ilbidhiqsikii marka uu soo gaadho iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% cabbirka ciyaaryahan caadi ah - tunnel cidhiidhi ah ayaa fudud.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: Ruuxa kaynta hore - aad ugu dheereysa geedaha, oo ay jecel yihiin duurjoogta, oo awood u leh in ay ku dhexgalaan cadawga xididdada badan.Roobku wuu bogsaday, laakiin Nether baa gubay.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Mid leh Dabeecadda
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Kooxaha cadawga ahi cidlada ayay kaa tagaan - kaliya waxay ka aargoosanayaan haddii aad marka hore wax ku dhufatid.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Si tartiib ah u bogsada marka aad la xiriirto biyaha.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Waxay kordhisaa xawliga kor u kaca inta lagu jiro biomes-ka kaynta.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Waxay qaadataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii inta uu ku sugan yahay Nether biomes.Kabaha Frost Walker waxay si buuxda uga hortagaan waxyeelada.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Madhan
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: Dragon-dhiiga leh oo cabsi leh - iska caabinta dabka iyo cabsi gelinta dugaagga, laakiin ololka daran ayaa si degdeg ah u gubanaya.
Ka difaaca dabka, lava, magma, iyo gubashada - masduulaagii-dhiigu waa mid kulul.
Si sahal ah ayuu ugu dabaashaa lafaha sida kuwa kale ugu dabaalanayaan biyaha.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: Waxa uu si bayaan ah wax uga dhex arkayaa laabada, oo aan ceeryaamo lahayn iyo cidhiidhiga gubanaya - moolka dhalaalayaa waxba ma qarinayo.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: Barkimo
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: Baalashu waxay jebiyaan dhicitaankaaga - wax dhaawac ah oo dhicis ah ma gaystaan.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: Inta badan makhluuqyada aan fiicneyn - xoolaha, tuulooyinka, duurjoogta - waxay ka cararaan joogitaankaaga adag.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: Maqaam Sare
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: 20% ka weyn ciyaaryahan caadi ah - way adag tahay in la seego.
power.neoorigins.draconic_attack_bonus.d: Waxay fulisaa 2 dhaawac dheeraad ah garaac kasta.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: Waxay qaadataa 1.5 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii biyo ama roob - dab wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu neefsado.
power.neoorigins.draconic_hunger_drain.d: 50% dhaqso ayuu u gubtaa adkeysi - ololku si kulul buu u gubaa.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Aarsasho
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: Socdaal aan dhimanin oo walaxda maaddada dhex mara oo tuura dalool engegan - ma qarqin karo oo wax buu arkay gudcurka, laakiin si tartiib ah ayuu u bogsadaa oo ku gubaa iftiinka qorraxda.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Lagu sifeeyay mid aan dhimanWaxyeeleeyey Caafimaadka degdega ah, waxaa bogsiiyey Burbur degdeg ah, oo ka difaaca Sunta.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: Uma baahna inuu neefsado.Wuxuu ku noolaan karaa ilaa xad aan xad lahayn.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Waxa uu si cad wax uga arki karaa gudcurka guud.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: Dab buu qabtaa oo wuxuu qaataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka iftiinka qorraxdu si toos ah u soo gaadho.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: Dib u soo kabashada caafimaadka dabiiciga ah ayaa hoos loo dhigay ilaa 40% ee caadiga ah.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: In yar
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: In yar oo dherer ah laakiin degdeg ah oo jilicsan - wax kasta wuu fuulaa, soo jiidaa alaabta, laakiin wuxuu ku dhuftaa sida baalasha oo kale.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: Wax yar
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Qabashada dusha sare
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Si fudud u cabbiri kara darbi kasta.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Kacsi
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: Dhaqso 20% ka badan qofka caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: Aad u yar oo dhicis ah ayaa macno leh.Ma qaado waxyeelo dhicid
power.neoorigins.tiny_item_magnetism.des: Alaabooyinka waxaa laga soo jiitay fogaan weyn.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: Waxay wax ka qabataa 2 dhaawac ka yar garaac kasta.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: Calool yar
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Gaajada 80% dhaqso ayey u gaajootaa - Jidhka yaryar ayaa si dhakhso ah u guba cuntada.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: God Dragon
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: Masduulaagii dabka iyo dhagaxa ahaa, oo dunida hoostiisa ku dhashay.Ku koraa kulaylka iyo gudcurka, oo wuxuu ku koraa awooddiisa buuxda muddo ka dib.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Foomka Cave Dragon
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: Qaado qaabka masduulaagii godka - makhluuqa magma iyo hadh.Sifooyinkaaga masduulaagii, korriinka, iyo awoodahaaga waxaa maamula Badbaadada Dragon.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Dragon kaynta
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: Waa masduulaa xidid iyo qodxan leh, Oo guriga dhexdiisa waxaa ku dhex yaal geedo qadiimi ah.Dulqaad iyo adkaysi, way sii xoogaysanaysaa marka ay qaan gaadho.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: Foomka Dragon kaynta
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: Qaado qaabka masduulaagii kaynta - makhluuqa canabka iyo sunta.Sifooyinkaaga masduulaagii, korriinka, iyo awoodahaaga waxaa maamula Badbaadada Dragon.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: Dragon badda
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: Masduulaagii duufaanka iyo duufaanka, oo u dhashay biyaha bannaan.Dhaqdhaqaaqa hirarka hoostooda, waxay la yimaadaan xooggooda iyagoo gabow ah.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Foomka Dragon Sea
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: Qaado qaabka masduulaagii badda - makhluuqa hadda iyo hillaaca.Sifooyinkaaga masduulaagii, korriinka, iyo awoodahaaga waxaa maamula Badbaadada Dragon.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Leviathan
